name: LocomotionAnimatorGeneratorWindow
src_typeComment: Window > Toolkit > Locomotion Animator Generator: select a folder of AnimationClips (or an object with clips as sub-assets, e.g. an imported FBX) and this builds a basic Idle/Walk/Run blend tree + Jump + Hang/Climb Animator Controller automatically — matching clips by name (case-insensitive substring: "idle", "walk", "run", "jump", "hang"/"ledge", "climb") instead of manually dragging clips into the Animator window every time. The Speed float this generates lines up 1:1 with Toolkit.Controller.LocomotionStateMachine.NormalizedSpeed (0=idle, 1=walk, 2=run) — see Toolkit/Controller/Locomotion/LocomotionAnimatorDriver.cs for the runtime bridge that feeds it.

src_members.comment: Separated from GenerateFromFolder so it's directly testable/callable with explicit clips, without needing real assets on disk in a folder. hang/climb default to null via overload below so existing callers built before Ledge Climb support don't need to change.

RunSelfTest
src_members.comment: Not exposed as a [MenuItem] on purpose — a leaf item and a submenu can't coexist at the same menu path in Unity, and this only needs to be reachable via -executeMethod for verification anyway. Creates real synthetic clip assets and runs the actual generator against them, then checks the resulting controller has the expected parameters/states — stronger than a compile-only check.
